bool valid_number(string token)
    if #token == 0 or #token > 6
        return false
    for: index < int(#token)
        if not "0123456789".contains(token[index])
            return false
    return token == "0" or token[0] != "0"

bool valid_literal(string token)
    if token == "0"
        return true
    digits := if token.starts_with("-") then token[1:] else token
    return valid_number(digits) and digits != "0"

string[] words(string text)
    return [for token := text.split(" ")[] if token != "" then token]

string[] read_lines(string path)
    content := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    lines := content.split(NL)
    return lines[0:<int(#lines) - 1]

class Formula(int variables, int[][] clauses, reason := "")

Formula read(string filename)
    variables := -1
    declared := -1
    int[][] clauses := []
    int[] partial := []
    lines := read_lines("input/" + filename)
    for: index < int(#lines)
        number := index + 1
        line := lines[index]
        tokens := words(line)
        if line.starts_with("c") or #tokens == 0
            continue
        if tokens[0] == "p"
            if variables >= 0
                return Formula(0, [], "duplicate header at line {number}")
            if #tokens != 4 or tokens[1] != "cnf" or not valid_number(tokens[2]) or not valid_number(tokens[3])
                return Formula(0, [], "bad header at line {number}")
            variables = int(tokens[2])
            declared = int(tokens[3])
        else
            if variables < 0
                return Formula(0, [], "missing header")
            for token := tokens[]
                if not valid_literal(token)
                    return Formula(0, [], "bad token {token} at line {number}")
                literal := int(token)
                magnitude := if literal < 0 then -literal else literal
                if magnitude > variables
                    return Formula(0, [], "literal out of range {token} at line {number}")
                if literal == 0
                    clauses = clauses.append(partial)
                    partial = []
                else
                    partial = partial.append(literal)
    if variables < 0
        return Formula(0, [], "missing header")
    if #partial > 0
        return Formula(0, [], "unterminated clause")
    if int(#clauses) != declared
        return Formula(0, [], "clause count mismatch header={declared} found={#clauses}")
    return Formula(variables, clauses)

string[] model_lines(bool[] model)
    string[] tokens := []
    for: index < int(#model)
        literal := if model[index] then index + 1 else -(index + 1)
        tokens = tokens.append("{literal}")
    tokens = tokens.append("0")
    string[] lines := []
    for: start < int(#tokens) step 10
        end := if start + 10 < int(#tokens) then start + 10 else int(#tokens)
        lines = lines.append("v " + tokens[start:<end].join(" "))
    return lines

int absolute(int value)
    return if value < 0 then -value else value

class Entry(int literal, string kind)
class Result(bool satisfiable, bool[] model, string[] trace, int decisions, int propagations, int conflicts, int max_depth)

class Round(int variables, int[][] clauses)
    assignment := array(nat(variables), fill = -1)
    int[][] watches := array(nat(2 * variables + 1), fill = [])
    Entry[] trail := []
    queue_head := 0
    string[] trace := []
    decisions := 0
    propagations := 0
    conflicts := 0
    max_depth := 0

    int value(int literal)
        truth := assignment[absolute(literal) - 1]
        return if truth < 0 then -1 elif literal > 0 then truth else 1 - truth

    void .assign(int literal, string kind)
        assignment[absolute(literal) - 1] = if literal > 0 then 1 else 0
        trail = trail.append(Entry(literal, kind))
        trace = trace.append(kind + "{literal}")

    void .conflict()
        conflicts += 1
        trace = trace.append("C")

    Result .run()
        for: index < int(#clauses)
            if #clauses[index] >= 2
                for: position < 2
                    watched := clauses[index][position] + variables
                    watches[watched] = watches[watched].append(index)
        for clause := clauses[]
            if #clause == 0
                .conflict()
                return Result(false, [], trace, decisions, propagations, conflicts, max_depth)
            if #clause == 1
                truth := value(clause[0])
                if truth == 0
                    .conflict()
                    return Result(false, [], trace, decisions, propagations, conflicts, max_depth)
                if truth < 0
                    .assign(clause[0], "P")
                    propagations += 1
        finished := false
        satisfiable := false
        while not finished
            found_conflict := false
            while queue_head < int(#trail)
                false_literal := -trail[queue_head].literal
                queue_head += 1
                watched := false_literal + variables
                watch_list := watches[watched]
                index := 0
                while index < int(#watch_list)
                    clause_id := watch_list[index]
                    clause := clauses[clause_id]
                    if clause[0] == false_literal
                        saved := clause[0]
                        clause[0] = clause[1]
                        clause[1] = saved
                        clauses[clause_id] = clause
                    other := clause[0]
                    if value(other) == 1
                        index += 1
                        continue
                    substitute := -1
                    for: 2 <= position < int(#clause)
                        if value(clause[position]) != 0
                            substitute = position
                            break
                    if substitute >= 0
                        saved := clause[1]
                        clause[1] = clause[substitute]
                        clause[substitute] = saved
                        clauses[clause_id] = clause
                        watch_list = watch_list[0:<index].concat(watch_list[index + 1:])
                        new_watch := clause[1] + variables
                        watches[new_watch] = watches[new_watch].append(clause_id)
                        continue
                    truth := value(other)
                    if truth == 0
                        .conflict()
                        found_conflict = true
                        break
                    if truth < 0
                        .assign(other, "P")
                        propagations += 1
                    index += 1
                watches[watched] = watch_list
                if found_conflict
                    break
            if found_conflict
                while #trail > 0 and trail[-1].kind != "D"
                    literal := trail[-1].literal
                    assignment[absolute(literal) - 1] = -1
                    trail = trail[0:<int(#trail) - 1]
                if #trail == 0
                    finished = true
                else
                    decision := trail[-1].literal
                    assignment[absolute(decision) - 1] = -1
                    trail = trail[0:<int(#trail) - 1]
                    .assign(-decision, "F")
                    queue_head = int(#trail) - 1
            else
                counts := array(nat(2 * variables + 1), fill = 0)
                for clause := clauses[]
                    satisfied := false
                    for literal := clause[]
                        if value(literal) == 1
                            satisfied = true
                            break
                    if not satisfied
                        for literal := clause[]
                            if value(literal) < 0
                                counts[literal + variables] += 1
                best := 0
                maximum := 0
                for: 1 <= variable <= variables
                    literals := [variable, -variable]
                    for literal := literals[]
                        if counts[literal + variables] > maximum
                            best = literal
                            maximum = counts[literal + variables]
                if best == 0
                    satisfiable = true
                    finished = true
                else
                    .assign(best, "D")
                    decisions += 1
                    depth := 0
                    for entry := trail[]
                        if entry.kind == "D" or entry.kind == "F"
                            depth += 1
                    if depth > max_depth
                        max_depth = depth
        model := [for truth := assignment[] then truth == 1]
        return Result(satisfiable, model, trace, decisions, propagations, conflicts, max_depth)

public import cnf = "./cnf_io.qui"

int absolute(int value)
    return if value < 0 then -value else value

cnf.Formula queens(int n)
    int[][] clauses := []
    for: row < n
        int[] clause := []
        for: 1 <= column <= n
            clause = clause.append(row * n + column)
        clauses = clauses.append(clause)
    for: 1 <= first <= n * n
        row_first := (first - 1) / n
        column_first := (first - 1) % n
        for: first + 1 <= second <= n * n
            row_second := (second - 1) / n
            column_second := (second - 1) % n
            if row_first == row_second or column_first == column_second or absolute(row_first - row_second) == absolute(column_first - column_second)
                clauses = clauses.append([-first, -second])
    return cnf.Formula(n * n, clauses)

cnf.Formula pigeon(int pigeons, int holes)
    int[][] clauses := []
    for: bird < pigeons
        int[] clause := []
        for: 1 <= hole <= holes
            clause = clause.append(bird * holes + hole)
        clauses = clauses.append(clause)
    for: bird < pigeons
        for: 1 <= first <= holes
            for: first + 1 <= second <= holes
                clauses = clauses.append([-(bird * holes + first), -(bird * holes + second)])
    for: 1 <= hole <= holes
        for: first < pigeons
            for: first + 1 <= second < pigeons
                clauses = clauses.append([-(first * holes + hole), -(second * holes + hole)])
    return cnf.Formula(pigeons * holes, clauses)

cnf.Formula coloring(int vertices, int[][] edges, int colors)
    int[][] clauses := []
    for: vertex < vertices
        int[] clause := []
        for: 1 <= color <= colors
            clause = clause.append(vertex * colors + color)
        clauses = clauses.append(clause)
    for: vertex < vertices
        for: 1 <= first <= colors
            for: first + 1 <= second <= colors
                clauses = clauses.append([-(vertex * colors + first), -(vertex * colors + second)])
    for edge := edges[]
        for: 1 <= color <= colors
            clauses = clauses.append([-((edge[0] - 1) * colors + color), -((edge[1] - 1) * colors + color)])
    return cnf.Formula(vertices * colors, clauses)

int[] positions(bool[] model, int rows, int width)
    int[] result := []
    for: row < rows
        for: 1 <= column <= width
            if model[row * width + column - 1]
                result = result.append(column)
                break
    return result

import encoders = "./encoders.qui"
import preprocess = "./preprocess.qui"
import dpll = "./dpll.qui"
import report = "./report.qui"

int absolute(int value)
    return if value < 0 then -value else value

bool only_name(string text)
    if #text < 1 or #text > 20
        return false
    for: index < int(#text)
        if not "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_".contains(text[index])
            return false
    return true

string[] commands()
    return ["SOLVE", "ENUM", "CORE", "QUEENS", "PIGEON", "COLOR", "CHROMATIC"]

string[] argument_types(string command)
    return if command == "SOLVE" or command == "CORE" then ["file"] elif command == "ENUM" then ["file", "limit"] elif command == "QUEENS" then ["small", "limit"] elif command == "PIGEON" then ["small", "small", "limit"] elif command == "COLOR" then ["graph", "color", "limit"] elif command == "CHROMATIC" then ["graph", "color"] else []

class Graph(string name, int vertices)
    int[][] edges := []
    invalid := ""
    degree := array(nat(vertices), fill = 0)
    bool[][] neighbors := array(nat(vertices), fill = array(nat(vertices), fill = false))
    greedy := array(nat(vertices), fill = 0)
    used := 0
    max_degree := 0

    void .finish()
        int[][] ordered := []
        for edge := edges[]
            place := int(#ordered)
            ordered = ordered.append(edge)
            while place > 0 and (edge[0] < ordered[place - 1][0] or (edge[0] == ordered[place - 1][0] and edge[1] < ordered[place - 1][1]))
                ordered[place] = ordered[place - 1]
                place -= 1
            ordered[place] = edge
        edges = ordered
        for edge := edges[]
            degree[edge[0] - 1] += 1
            degree[edge[1] - 1] += 1
            neighbors[edge[0] - 1][edge[1] - 1] = true
            neighbors[edge[1] - 1][edge[0] - 1] = true
        int[] order := []
        for: vertex < vertices
            place := int(#order)
            order = order.append(vertex)
            while place > 0 and degree[vertex] > degree[order[place - 1]]
                order[place] = order[place - 1]
                place -= 1
            order[place] = vertex
        for vertex := order[]
            present := array(nat(vertices + 1), fill = false)
            for: adjacent < vertices
                if neighbors[vertex][adjacent] and greedy[adjacent] > 0
                    present[greedy[adjacent]] = true
            candidate := 1
            while present[candidate]
                candidate += 1
            greedy[vertex] = candidate
            if candidate > used
                used = candidate
            if degree[vertex] > max_degree
                max_degree = degree[vertex]

Graph[] load_graphs()
    Graph[] graphs := []
    current := -1
    string[] lines := encoders.cnf.read_lines("input/graphs.txt")
    for: index < int(#lines)
        line := lines[index]
        if current < 0
            if line != "" and not line.starts_with("#")
                header := line.split(" ")
                vertices := int(header[2])
                current = int(#graphs)
                graphs = graphs.append(Graph(header[1], vertices))
            continue
        graph := graphs[current]
        if line == "END"
            .graph.finish()
            graphs[current] = graph
            current = -1
            continue
        if graph.invalid != ""
            continue
        tokens := line.split(" ")
        reason := ""
        if #tokens != 2 or not encoders.cnf.valid_number(tokens[0]) or not encoders.cnf.valid_number(tokens[1])
            reason = "bad edge line"
        else
            first := int(tokens[0])
            second := int(tokens[1])
            if first < 1 or first > graph.vertices or second < 1 or second > graph.vertices
                reason = "vertex out of range"
            elif first == second
                reason = "self loop"
            else
                a := if first < second then first else second
                b := if first < second then second else first
                duplicate := false
                for edge := graph.edges[]
                    if edge[0] == a and edge[1] == b
                        duplicate = true
                        break
                if duplicate
                    reason = "duplicate edge"
                else
                    graph.edges = graph.edges.append([a, b])
        if reason != ""
            graph.invalid = reason + " at line {index + 1}"
        graphs[current] = graph
    return graphs

int graph_index(Graph[] graphs, string name)
    for: index < int(#graphs)
        if graphs[index].name == name
            return index
    return -1

class Analysis()
    failure_model := -1
    failure_clause := -1
    int[] distribution := []
    int[] safe := []
    int[] diversity := []
    int[] backbone := []

class Solution(int variables, int[][] clauses, preprocess.Preparation[] preparations)
    bool[][] models := []
    status := "UNSAT"
    rounds := 0
    stop := "limit"
    string[] trace := []
    decisions := 0
    propagations := 0
    conflicts := 0
    max_depth := 0
    int removed := preparations[0].counts[7]
    colors := 0

Solution solve_formula(int variables, int[][] clauses, int limit)
    preparation := preprocess.run(variables, clauses, limit == 1)
    solution := Solution(variables, clauses, [preparation])
    int[][] blocking := []
    if preparation.empty_clause >= 0
        solution.stop = "preprocess"
    else
        while int(#solution.models) < limit
            solution.rounds += 1
            search := dpll.Round(variables, preparation.clauses.concat(blocking))
            result := .search.run()
            if solution.rounds == 1
                solution.trace = result.trace
            solution.decisions += result.decisions
            solution.propagations += result.propagations
            solution.conflicts += result.conflicts
            if result.max_depth > solution.max_depth
                solution.max_depth = result.max_depth
            if not result.satisfiable
                solution.stop = "all"
                break
            model := result.model
            for: variable < variables
                if preparation.fixed[variable] >= 0
                    model[variable] = preparation.fixed[variable] == 1
            solution.models = solution.models.append(model)
            int[] block := []
            for variable := preparation.active[]
                block = block.append(if model[variable - 1] then -variable else variable)
            blocking = blocking.append(block)
    if #solution.models > 0
        solution.status = "SAT"
    return solution

bool true_literal(bool[] model, int literal)
    return if literal > 0 then model[literal - 1] else not model[-literal - 1]

bool satisfies(bool[] model, int[][] clauses)
    for clause := clauses[]
        satisfied := false
        for literal := clause[]
            if true_literal(model, literal)
                satisfied = true
                break
        if not satisfied
            return false
    return true

Analysis analyze(bool[][] models, int[][] clauses, int variables)
    analysis := Analysis()
    for: index < int(#models)
        for: number < int(#clauses)
            if not satisfies(models[index], [clauses[number]])
                analysis.failure_model = index + 1
                analysis.failure_clause = number + 1
                break
        if analysis.failure_model >= 0
            break
    for clause := clauses[]
        count := 0
        for literal := clause[]
            if true_literal(models[0], literal)
                count += 1
        analysis.distribution = analysis.distribution.append(count)
    for: variable < variables
        inverted := models[0]
        inverted[variable] = not inverted[variable]
        if satisfies(inverted, clauses)
            analysis.safe = analysis.safe.append(variable + 1)
        same := true
        for model := models[]
            if model[variable] != models[0][variable]
                same = false
                break
        if same
            analysis.backbone = analysis.backbone.append(if models[0][variable] then variable + 1 else -(variable + 1))
    for: first < int(#models)
        for: first + 1 <= second < int(#models)
            distance := 0
            for: variable < variables
                if models[first][variable] != models[second][variable]
                    distance += 1
            analysis.diversity = analysis.diversity.append(distance)
    return analysis

class Core(int[] clauses, int decisions, int conflicts)

Core unsat_core(int variables, int[][] clauses)
    remaining := array(#clauses, fill = true)
    decisions := 0
    conflicts := 0
    for: remove < int(#clauses)
        int[][] candidate := []
        for: index < int(#clauses)
            if remaining[index] and index != remove
                candidate = candidate.append(clauses[index])
        testing := solve_formula(variables, candidate, 1)
        decisions += testing.decisions
        conflicts += testing.conflicts
        if testing.status == "UNSAT"
            remaining[remove] = false
    int[] core := []
    for: index < int(#clauses)
        if remaining[index]
            core = core.append(index + 1)
    return Core(core, decisions, conflicts)

class Job(int number, string text, string command, string[] args)
    reason := ""
    graph := -1
    colors := 0
    chromatic := -1
    Solution[] attempts := []
    Analysis[] analyses := []
    Core[] cores := []
    decisions := 0
    propagations := 0
    conflicts := 0
    max_depth := 0
    rounds := 0
    removed := 0

Job[] load_jobs()
    Job[] jobs := []
    for line := encoders.cnf.read_lines("input/jobs.txt")[]
        if line != "" and not line.starts_with("#")
            string[] tokens := line.split(" ")
            jobs = jobs.append(Job(int(#jobs) + 1, line, tokens[0], tokens[1:]))
    return jobs

string validate(Job job, Graph[] graphs)
    types := argument_types(job.command)
    if #types == 0
        return "unknown command {job.command}"
    if #job.args != #types
        return "wrong argument count"
    for: index < int(#types)
        argument := job.args[index]
        kind := types[index]
        if kind == "file"
            if not argument.ends_with(".cnf") or not only_name(argument[0:<int(#argument) - 4])
                return "bad file name {argument}"
        elif kind == "graph"
            selected := graph_index(graphs, argument)
            if selected < 0
                return "unknown graph {argument}"
            if graphs[selected].invalid != ""
                return "invalid graph {argument}: {graphs[selected].invalid}"
        else
            if not encoders.cnf.valid_number(argument)
                return "bad number {argument}"
            value := int(argument)
            maximum := if kind == "small" then 8 elif kind == "color" then 6 else 200
            if value < 1 or value > maximum
                return "out of range {argument}"
    return ""

Job execute(Job job, Graph[] graphs)
    job.reason = validate(job, graphs)
    if job.reason != ""
        return job
    if job.command == "CHROMATIC"
        job.graph = graph_index(graphs, job.args[0])
        graph := graphs[job.graph]
        bound := int(job.args[1])
        for: 1 <= colors <= bound
            encoders.cnf.Formula formula := encoders.coloring(graph.vertices, graph.edges, colors)
            solution := solve_formula(formula.variables, formula.clauses, 1)
            solution.colors = colors
            job.attempts = job.attempts.append(solution)
            job.decisions += solution.decisions
            job.propagations += solution.propagations
            job.conflicts += solution.conflicts
            if solution.max_depth > job.max_depth
                job.max_depth = solution.max_depth
            job.rounds += solution.rounds
            job.removed += solution.removed
            job.colors = colors
            if solution.status == "SAT"
                job.chromatic = colors
                break
    else
        formula := encoders.cnf.Formula(0, [])
        limit := 1
        if job.command == "SOLVE" or job.command == "ENUM" or job.command == "CORE"
            formula = encoders.cnf.read(job.args[0])
            if formula.reason != ""
                job.reason = formula.reason
                return job
            if job.command == "ENUM"
                limit = int(job.args[1])
        elif job.command == "QUEENS"
            n := int(job.args[0])
            formula = encoders.queens(n)
            limit = int(job.args[1])
        elif job.command == "PIGEON"
            pigeons := int(job.args[0])
            holes := int(job.args[1])
            formula = encoders.pigeon(pigeons, holes)
            limit = int(job.args[2])
        else
            job.graph = graph_index(graphs, job.args[0])
            job.colors = int(job.args[1])
            graph := graphs[job.graph]
            formula = encoders.coloring(graph.vertices, graph.edges, job.colors)
            limit = int(job.args[2])
        solution := solve_formula(formula.variables, formula.clauses, limit)
        job.attempts = [solution]
        job.decisions = solution.decisions
        job.propagations = solution.propagations
        job.conflicts = solution.conflicts
        job.max_depth = solution.max_depth
        job.rounds = solution.rounds
        job.removed = solution.removed
        if job.command == "CORE" and solution.status == "UNSAT"
            job.cores = [unsat_core(formula.variables, formula.clauses)]
    solution := job.attempts[-1]
    if #solution.models > 0
        job.analyses = [analyze(solution.models, solution.clauses, solution.variables)]
    return job

string heading(Job job)
    return "JOB {job.number} {job.text}"

string formula_summary(int variables, int[][] clauses)
    lengths := [for clause := clauses[] then int(#clause)]
    literals := 0
    for length := lengths[]
        literals += length
    return "variables={variables} clauses={#clauses} literals={literals} lengths=" + report.frequency(lengths)

string graph_summary(Graph graph)
    return "graph vertices={graph.vertices} edges={#graph.edges} max_degree={graph.max_degree} greedy={graph.used}"

string search_report(int decisions, int propagations, int conflicts, int max_depth)
    return "search " + report.named(["decisions", "propagations", "conflicts", "max_depth"], ["{decisions}", "{propagations}", "{conflicts}", "{max_depth}"])

string[] preprocessing_report(preprocess.Preparation preparation)
    counts := preparation.counts
    records := preparation.records
    lines := ["preprocess " + report.named(["pure", "tautologies", "duplicate_literals", "unit_fixed", "unit_removed", "subsumed", "pure_fixed", "pure_removed", "removed"], [if preparation.pure then "on" else "off", "{counts[0]}", "{counts[1]}", "{counts[2]}", "{counts[3]}", "{counts[4]}", "{counts[5]}", "{counts[6]}", "{counts[7]}"]), "removed_clauses " + report.named(["tautology", "unit", "subsumed", "pure"], [report.number_list(records[0]), report.number_list(records[1]), report.number_list(records[2]), report.number_list(records[3])])]
    if preparation.empty_clause >= 0
        lines = lines.append("simplified empty_clause={preparation.empty_clause}")
    else
        lengths := [for clause := preparation.clauses[] then int(#clause)]
        literals := 0
        for length := lengths[]
            literals += length
        int[] fixed := []
        for: index < int(#preparation.fixed)
            if preparation.fixed[index] >= 0
                fixed = fixed.append(if preparation.fixed[index] == 1 then index + 1 else -(index + 1))
        lines = lines.concat(["simplified clauses={#lengths} literals={literals} lengths=" + report.frequency(lengths) + " fixed={#fixed} active={#preparation.active}", "fixed literals=" + report.number_list(fixed)])
    return lines

string verification_report(Solution solution, Analysis analysis)
    if analysis.failure_model >= 0
        return "verify failed model={analysis.failure_model} clause={analysis.failure_clause}"
    return "verify ok models={#solution.models} clauses={#solution.clauses} true_literals=" + report.frequency(analysis.distribution)

string[] analysis_report(Solution solution, Analysis analysis)
    lines := [verification_report(solution, analysis), "flips safe={#analysis.safe} variables=" + report.number_list(analysis.safe)]
    if #analysis.diversity > 0
        ordered := analysis.diversity.sorted()
        lines = lines.append("diversity pairs={#ordered} min_distance={ordered[0]} max_distance={ordered[-1]}")
    if solution.stop == "all"
        lines = lines.append("backbone size={#analysis.backbone} literals=" + report.number_list(analysis.backbone))
    return lines

string[] result_paragraph(Job job, Graph[] graphs)
    lines := [heading(job)]
    if job.reason != ""
        return lines.append("error {job.reason}")
    solution := job.attempts[-1]
    if job.command == "CHROMATIC"
        lines = lines.append(graph_summary(graphs[job.graph]))
        for attempt := job.attempts[]
            lines = lines.append("attempt " + report.named(["k", "clauses", "removed", "result", "stop", "decisions", "propagations", "conflicts", "max_depth"], ["{attempt.colors}", "{#attempt.clauses}", "{attempt.removed}", attempt.status, attempt.stop, "{attempt.decisions}", "{attempt.propagations}", "{attempt.conflicts}", "{attempt.max_depth}"]))
        chromatic := if job.chromatic < 0 then "-" else "{job.chromatic}"
        lines = lines.concat(["result {solution.status} chromatic={chromatic} attempts={#job.attempts}", search_report(job.decisions, job.propagations, job.conflicts, job.max_depth)])
        if #job.analyses > 0
            analysis := job.analyses[0]
            lines = lines.concat([verification_report(solution, analysis), "flips safe={#analysis.safe} variables=" + report.number_list(analysis.safe)])
    else
        if job.command == "COLOR"
            lines = lines.append(graph_summary(graphs[job.graph]))
        lines = lines.append("formula " + formula_summary(solution.variables, solution.clauses)).concat(preprocessing_report(solution.preparations[0]))
        lines = lines.concat(["result {solution.status} models={#solution.models} rounds={solution.rounds} stop={solution.stop}", search_report(solution.decisions, solution.propagations, solution.conflicts, solution.max_depth)])
        if solution.rounds > 0
            count := if #solution.trace < 12 then int(#solution.trace) else 12
            text := if count == 0 then "-" else solution.trace[0:<count].join(" ")
            if #solution.trace > 12
                text += " +{int(#solution.trace) - 12}"
            lines = lines.append("trace " + text)
        if #job.analyses > 0
            lines = lines.concat(analysis_report(solution, job.analyses[0]))
        if #job.cores > 0
            core := job.cores[0]
            lines = lines.append("core size={#core.clauses} decisions={core.decisions} conflicts={core.conflicts} clauses=" + report.number_list(core.clauses))
    return lines

bool sequence_equal(int[] first, int[] second)
    if #first != #second
        return false
    for: index < int(#first)
        if first[index] != second[index]
            return false
    return true

bool sequence_less(int[] first, int[] second)
    for: index < int(#first)
        if first[index] != second[index]
            return first[index] < second[index]
    return false

class Symmetry(int[] canonical, int orbit)

Symmetry canonical_queens(int[] columns)
    n := int(#columns)
    int[][] variants := []
    int[][] unique_arrangements := []
    for: transform < 8
        current := array(nat(n), fill = 0)
        for: index < n
            row := index + 1
            column := columns[index]
            r := row
            c := column
            if transform == 1
                r = column
                c = n + 1 - row
            elif transform == 2
                r = n + 1 - row
                c = n + 1 - column
            elif transform == 3
                r = n + 1 - column
                c = row
            elif transform == 4
                c = n + 1 - column
            elif transform == 5
                r = n + 1 - row
            elif transform == 6
                r = column
                c = row
            elif transform == 7
                r = n + 1 - column
                c = n + 1 - row
            current[r - 1] = c
        variants = variants.append(current)
        known := false
        for before := unique_arrangements[]
            if sequence_equal(current, before)
                known = true
                break
        if not known
            unique_arrangements = unique_arrangements.append(current)
    best := variants[0]
    for variant := variants[]
        if sequence_less(variant, best)
            best = variant
    return Symmetry(best, int(#unique_arrangements))

class Coloring(int[] canonical, int used)

Coloring canonical_colors(int[] colors)
    int[] seen := []
    int[] canonical := []
    for color := colors[]
        selected := -1
        for: index < int(#seen)
            if seen[index] == color
                selected = index
        if selected < 0
            selected = int(#seen)
            seen = seen.append(color)
        canonical = canonical.append(selected + 1)
    return Coloring(canonical, int(#seen))

class Group(int number, int first, int[] canonical, int orbit)
    found := 0

string[] boards(Job job, Graph[] graphs)
    solution := job.attempts[-1]
    if job.command == "PIGEON"
        p := int(job.args[0])
        h := int(job.args[1])
        lines := ["PIGEON job={job.number} pigeons={p} holes={h}"]
        for: index < int(#solution.models)
            places := encoders.positions(solution.models[index], p, h)
            occupied := array(nat(h + 1), fill = false)
            for hole := places[]
                occupied[hole] = true
            int[] empty := []
            for: 1 <= hole <= h
                if not occupied[hole]
                    empty = empty.append(hole)
            lines = lines.append("assignment {index + 1} holes=" + report.number_list(places) + " empty=" + report.number_list(empty))
        expected := if p <= h then 1 else 0
        if p <= h
            for: offset < p
                expected *= h - offset
        return lines.append("summary assignments={#solution.models} stop={solution.stop} expected={expected}")
    queens := job.command == "QUEENS"
    int rows := if queens then int(job.args[0]) else graphs[job.graph].vertices
    width := if queens then rows else job.colors
    string[] lines := []
    if queens
        lines = ["QUEENS job={job.number} n={rows}"]
    else
        graph := graphs[job.graph]
        lines = ["{job.command} job={job.number} graph={graph.name} vertices={rows} edges={#graph.edges} colors={width}", "greedy used={graph.used} colors=" + report.number_list(graph.greedy)]
    Group[] groups := []
    for: index < int(#solution.models)
        places := encoders.positions(solution.models[index], rows, width)
        int[] canonical := []
        orbit := 0
        used := 0
        if queens
            symmetry := canonical_queens(places)
            canonical = symmetry.canonical
            orbit = symmetry.orbit
        else
            coloring := canonical_colors(places)
            canonical = coloring.canonical
            used = coloring.used
        selected := -1
        for: group < int(#groups)
            if sequence_equal(canonical, groups[group].canonical)
                selected = group
                break
        first := selected < 0
        if first
            selected = int(#groups)
            groups = groups.append(Group(selected + 1, index + 1, canonical, orbit))
        groups[selected].found += 1
        if queens
            lines = lines.append("solution {index + 1} columns=" + report.number_list(places) + " class={selected + 1}")
            if first
                lines = lines.concat(report.queens_board(places))
        else
            sizes := array(nat(width), fill = 0)
            for color := places[]
                sizes[color - 1] += 1
            lines = lines.append("coloring {index + 1} colors=" + report.number_list(places) + " used={used} sizes=" + report.number_list(sizes) + " class={selected + 1}")
    for group := groups[]
        text := "class {group.number}"
        if queens
            text += " orbit={group.orbit}"
        lines = lines.append(text + " found={group.found} first={group.first} canonical=" + report.number_list(group.canonical))
    name := if queens then "solutions" else "colorings"
    return lines.append("summary {name}={#solution.models} stop={solution.stop} classes={#groups}")

string[] summary(Job[] jobs, Job[] valid)
    sat := 0
    models := 0
    rounds := 0
    decisions := 0
    propagations := 0
    conflicts := 0
    removed := 0
    for job := valid[]
        solution := job.attempts[-1]
        if solution.status == "SAT"
            sat += 1
        models += int(#solution.models)
        rounds += job.rounds
        decisions += job.decisions
        propagations += job.propagations
        conflicts += job.conflicts
        removed += job.removed
    lines := ["SUMMARY jobs={#jobs} sat={sat} unsat={int(#valid) - sat} error={int(#jobs) - int(#valid)}", "totals models={models} rounds={rounds} decisions={decisions} propagations={propagations} conflicts={conflicts} removed_clauses={removed}"]
    for command := commands()[]
        count := 0
        yes := 0
        no := 0
        d := 0
        p := 0
        c := 0
        for job := valid[]
            if job.command == command
                count += 1
                if job.attempts[-1].status == "SAT"
                    yes += 1
                else
                    no += 1
                d += job.decisions
                p += job.propagations
                c += job.conflicts
        if count > 0
            lines = lines.append("command {command} jobs={count} sat={yes} unsat={no} decisions={d} propagations={p} conflicts={c}")
    if #valid > 0
        hardest := 0
        deepest := 0
        busiest := 0
        for: index < int(#valid)
            if valid[index].conflicts > valid[hardest].conflicts
                hardest = index
            if valid[index].max_depth > valid[deepest].max_depth
                deepest = index
            if valid[index].propagations > valid[busiest].propagations
                busiest = index
        lines = lines.concat(["hardest job={valid[hardest].number} conflicts={valid[hardest].conflicts}", "deepest job={valid[deepest].number} max_depth={valid[deepest].max_depth}", "busiest job={valid[busiest].number} propagations={valid[busiest].propagations}"])
    return lines

int absolute(int value)
    return if value < 0 then -value else value

bool contains(int[] values, int target)
    for value := values[]
        if value == target
            return true
    return false

class Clause(int number, int[] literals)
class Preparation(int[][] clauses, int[] fixed, int[] active, int[] counts, int[][] records, int empty_clause, bool pure)

Preparation run(int variables, int[][] original, bool use_pure)
    Clause[] working := []
    fixed := array(nat(variables), fill = -1)
    counts := array(8, fill = 0)
    int[][] records := array(4, fill = [])
    for: index < int(#original)
        clause := original[index]
        present := array(nat(2 * variables + 1), fill = false)
        for literal := clause[]
            present[literal + variables] = true
        tautology := false
        for literal := clause[]
            if present[-literal + variables]
                tautology = true
                break
        if tautology
            counts[0] += 1
            records[0] = records[0].append(index + 1)
        else
            int[] reduced := []
            for literal := clause[]
                if contains(reduced, literal)
                    counts[1] += 1
                else
                    reduced = reduced.append(literal)
            working = working.append(Clause(index + 1, reduced))
    empty_clause := -1
    applying := true
    while applying
        unit := 0
        for clause := working[]
            if #clause.literals == 0
                empty_clause = clause.number
                break
        if empty_clause >= 0
            break
        for clause := working[]
            if #clause.literals == 1
                unit = clause.literals[0]
                break
        if unit == 0
            break
        fixed[absolute(unit) - 1] = if unit > 0 then 1 else 0
        counts[2] += 1
        Clause[] surviving := []
        for clause := working[]
            if contains(clause.literals, unit)
                counts[3] += 1
                records[1] = records[1].append(clause.number)
            else
                surviving = surviving.append(Clause(clause.number, [for literal := clause.literals[] if literal != -unit then literal]))
        working = surviving
    if empty_clause < 0
        removed := array(#working, fill = false)
        sets := array(#working, fill = array(nat(2 * variables + 1), fill = false))
        for: index < int(#working)
            for literal := working[index].literals[]
                sets[index][literal + variables] = true
        for: second < int(#working)
            for: first < int(#working)
                if first == second or not (#working[first].literals < #working[second].literals or first < second)
                    continue
                subset := true
                for literal := working[first].literals[]
                    if not sets[second][literal + variables]
                        subset = false
                        break
                if subset
                    removed[second] = true
                    break
        Clause[] surviving := []
        for: index < int(#working)
            if removed[index]
                counts[4] += 1
                records[2] = records[2].append(working[index].number)
            else
                surviving = surviving.append(working[index])
        working = surviving
        if use_pure
            eliminating := true
            while eliminating
                present := array(nat(2 * variables + 1), fill = false)
                for clause := working[]
                    for literal := clause.literals[]
                        present[literal + variables] = true
                pure := array(nat(2 * variables + 1), fill = false)
                pure_count := 0
                for: 1 <= variable <= variables
                    literal := if present[variable + variables] and not present[-variable + variables] then variable elif present[-variable + variables] and not present[variable + variables] then -variable else 0
                    if literal != 0
                        pure[literal + variables] = true
                        pure_count += 1
                        fixed[variable - 1] = if literal > 0 then 1 else 0
                if pure_count == 0
                    break
                counts[5] += pure_count
                surviving = []
                for clause := working[]
                    satisfied := false
                    for literal := clause.literals[]
                        if pure[literal + variables]
                            satisfied = true
                            break
                    if satisfied
                        counts[6] += 1
                        records[3] = records[3].append(clause.number)
                    else
                        surviving = surviving.append(clause)
                working = surviving
    counts[7] = counts[0] + counts[3] + counts[4] + counts[6]
    for: index < 4
        records[index] = records[index].sorted()
    clauses := [for clause := working[] then clause.literals]
    int[] active := []
    for: index < variables
        if fixed[index] < 0
            active = active.append(index + 1)
    return Preparation(clauses, fixed, active, counts, records, empty_clause, use_pure)

string named(string[] names, string[] values)
    string[] fields := []
    for: index < int(#names)
        fields = fields.append(names[index] + "=" + values[index])
    return fields.join(" ")

string number_list(int[] values)
    return if #values == 0 then "-" else [for value := values[] then "{value}"].join(",")

string frequency(int[] values)
    ordered := values.sorted()
    string[] fields := []
    index := 0
    while index < int(#ordered)
        end := index + 1
        while end < int(#ordered) and ordered[end] == ordered[index]
            end += 1
        fields = fields.append("{ordered[index]}:{end - index}")
        index = end
    return if #fields == 0 then "-" else fields.join(",")

string[] queens_board(int[] columns)
    count := int(#columns)
    return [for column := columns[] then "." * nat(column - 1) + "Q" + "." * nat(count - column)]

void save_lines(string filename, string[] lines)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + filename)
    .writer1(if #lines == 0 then "" else lines.join(NL) + NL)

void save_paragraphs(string filename, string[][] paragraphs)
    parts := [for lines := paragraphs[] then lines.join(NL)]
    writer2 := file.write("output/" + filename)
    .writer2(if #parts == 0 then "" else parts.join(NL + NL) + NL)
